svg.title: EnIGMA Capture The Flag architecture diagram
svg.desc: Inventory and relationships: left frame f01 is a dark Capture The Flag problem card containing a faint flag/circuit icon, cyan title and italic challenge description. A gray rightward arrow connects it to main frame f02. Main frame f02 contains the EnIGMA logo and a green components area f03. Inside f03, the origin is the Language Model box at left; blue command flow proceeds upward/right through LM-cybersecurity commands, LM-friendly commands, and to the Computer panel f05. Red feedback flow returns from the Computer through LM-friendly environment feedback, summarizer, and upward into the Language Model. The right interfaces pane f04 contains the SWE-Agent Computer Interfaces header and two command boxes. Computer panel f05 lists Terminal, Debugger, Connect, Filesystem and ftp. Challenge Server frame f06 sits to the far right, connected to Computer by a bidirectional orange arrow. Whole-section symmetry is a horizontal command/feedback split: blue command path on top, orange-red feedback path below, with parallel rounded command modules.
